definitions: Perform a series of mechanical or chemical operations on (something) in order to change or preserve it.
Deal with (a person or a request) in an official and structured way.
Convert (data) into a form that can be stored or analysed by a computer.
Walk or march in a procession.
examples: The factory processes raw materials into finished products.
Your application will be processed within five working days.
The computer processes information very quickly.
The graduates processed into the hall.
